notes.title: WE ARE FOOTBALL 2024 Kicks Off Its Third Major Update
notes.notes:
The ultimate football management experience, WE ARE FOOTBALL 2024, is ready for its next big update with the Season 2024/25 launch! This third major update introduces new features, competitions, and tools designed to give football managers even more control over their careers, clubs, and strategies.

Whether you're looking to build a club dynasty, fine-tune your team’s tactics, or immerse yourself deeper in the world of football management, the Season 2024/25 update brings everything you need to make your mark.
 
[h1]Key Highlights of the Season 2024/25 Update:[/h1]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840987/d4464f64a52c6b2b189c6a614d0bca3b26095222.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840987/457dc585e305de15bf0fc0ce30d639b8e3f833ef.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840987/c4df9305eb88fc6592dc10e2ee3074179c26977f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840987/b787de4d9f506121b47b7133a2eacc6a7da63e29.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840987/e3a84526322707bbfa91308d5438aa2cf2d63898.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840987/c4eae1260788fa0e2e11c29e05d749128df2db4d.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840987/830ae2a931112f3400a060f89e00d47075a352c8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840987/181023db50eed933665cda1610ef1fb6ac9a4df1.png[/img][/url]
[list]
[*] [h3]Edit Your World, Your Way[/h3]
Now, you can edit both employees and competitions within your save game, giving you unprecedented control over every detail of your football universe. Customize leagues, adjust competition structures, and fine-tune your staff to match your managerial vision.
[*] [h3]100 Manager Trophies: Build Your Legacy[/h3]
Showcase your managerial career with the new 3D Room feature, where you can collect up to 100 trophies as proof of your success. It’s the ultimate display of your footballing legacy, comparable to a personal museum.
[*] [h3]Expanded Player Management Tools[/h3]
Gain more control over your squad with new features like trial training for potential new players and a watchlist for players without having to scout them. Plus, youth players can now learn new positions, giving you more flexibility in developing the next generation of talent.
[*] [h3]Enhanced Club Customization[/h3]
Build your club both on and off the pitch. Construct apartment buildings on your club premises, and benefit from rental income from catering facilities, including canteens and restaurants. Even your club museum can generate profit or loss, adding even more depth to financial management.
[*] [h3]Dynamic Fan Management[/h3]
Dive into fan culture with the ability to set and adjust fan friendships and rivalries. Keep an eye on fan merchandise sales with pie charts to track income, and fine-tune prices to maximize support and revenue.
[*] [h3]Improved Financial Tools[/h3]
Track your club's financial health with the new balance sheet pie chart on the arrival screen and monitor your passive income with the new summary screen. This update gives you the insights needed to lead your club to sustained financial stability.
[*] [h3]New European and Club World Competition Modes[/h3]
Compete in new European Club Competition modes and the prestigious Club World Championship, giving you even more tournaments to strive for as you build your trophy cabinet.
[*] [h3]Visual and Strategic Enhancements[/h3]
Enjoy new action shots from matches featured in the in-game newspaper, adding a layer of immersion to your managerial journey. Plus, the inclusion of a heatmap screen lets you analyze match data and make informed tactical adjustments.
[*] [h3]Coach of the Year Award[/h3]
Put your managerial skills to the test as you compete for the Coach of the Year award. Your successes on the pitch could now be crowned with personal accolades!
[/list]

[previewyoutube=7mh2_O2wqRU;full][/previewyoutube]

As always, we would like to sincerely thank you, our passionate community, for your valuable feedback, support, and patience. Your contribution continues to shape We Are Football 2024 into the ultimate football management simulation.

Here is the complete list of new features. In addition to new competitions and a new database, there are a number of enhancements and improvements focussing on your personal manager career:
[list]
[*] Edit employees in the savegame
[*] Edit competitions in the game state
[*] 3D room with a total of 100 manager trophies (comparable to the museum) 
[*] 74 instead of 42 Achievements
[*] Trial training 
[*] Watchlist for players without scouting
[*] Learning new positions even for youth players	
[*] Possibility to take the staff with you to future clubs
[*] Adjustable prices for fan articles 
[*] Pie chart for merchandise sales
[*] 2 additional roof types: Reef roof and banana roof
[*] Tenement houses can be built on the club grounds
[*] Catering now generates rental income (canteen, restaurant, sausage stands)
[*] New screen with a summary of passive club income
[*] Club museum can make a profit or a loss
[*] New info for players after career end, including what the player has done afterward
[*] Pie chart for the balance sheet on the start screen
[*] Assistant screen now additionally integrated into the game starts
[*] Club foundation => fan friendships and rivals can be set
[*] Fan friendships and rivals can be changed in the current game for your own club in the club profile
[*] Display of all title wins and championships in the lower leagues in the club profile
[*] End-of-season summary: Screen with promoted and relegated teams
[*] Balance sheets in team comparison for clubs and national teams
[*] Statistics update int. competitions other continents
[*] Vote for coach of the year
[*] Coach of the Year statistics
[*] Action shots from the matches are used in the newspaper
[*] Small tutorial in the start and main menu
[*] You can record your own match commentary
[*] Heatmap screen
[*] New European Cup modes (but originals must be licensed)
[*] Club World Cup
[*] New scenes
[*] Optional 3D CamCarpets (next to the goals)
[list]

notes.title: We Are Football 2024 Update 2

It's packed with enhancements across various aspects of the game.

[h3]Some of the highlights included in update 2:[/h3][list]
[*]Create a club extension: Create your own team (draft mode); the users can additionally select their players when starting their own club (within a reasonable budget)
[*]Banner and fan update (visible in the stadium)

The game requires a lot of memory for large user databases. If this is not available, the game may crash.

We therefore recommend:[list]
[*]Be sure to increase the size of the Windows pagefile, our suggestion would be 16 GB
[*]Instructions on how to do this can be found pinned at the top under "Discussions", it's straightforward
[*]Make sure that there is enough free disc space available
[*]For fast gaming: The larger the DB, the more RAM should be available
[*]Switch off countries that are not required if possible
[/list]

notes.title: Kick Off TODAY!
notes.notes:
Today marks the kickoff of a new era in football management as WE ARE FOOTBALL 2024 hits the digital shelves. Developed by the minds behind the legendary On the Ball and EA SPORTS FIFA Manager Series, this game revolutionizes the genre with its unparalleled focus on management functions.

Immerse yourself in the dynamic world of football, where you can take the reins of an existing club or build your own from scratch. Whether managing men's or women's teams, you will navigate the highs and lows of the beautiful game, striving to etch your name into the annals of managerial greatness.

[previewyoutube=ZNhn4nsBjt0;full][/previewyoutube]

WE ARE FOOTBALL 2024's immersive 3D game engine, allows managers to influence on-pitch action through instructional shouts directly. The possibilities are endless, from simulating matches across decades to experiencing games in conference mode. Relive match highlights, dissect goals, and revel in a comprehensive season summary like never before.

WE ARE FOOTBALL 2024 isn't just a game; it's a journey into the heart of football management. With its comprehensive features and depth, it's time to experience the thrill of the beautiful game like never before.

Are you ready to take your team to glory? Dive into WE ARE FOOTBALL 2024 today and make your mark on football history.

notes.title: Unleash Your Inner Gaffer
notes.notes:
Brace yourselves, football aficionados! [b]WE ARE FOOTBALL 2024[/b], a love letter to the football management experience from the brilliant minds behind the legendary On the Ball and EA SPORTS FIFA Manager Series, kicks off with a Demo and will be released on [b]March 4th[/b].

Dive into the captivating world of professional football. Whether choosing an existing club or guiding your local home team to cup victories, [b]WE ARE FOOTBALL 2024[/b] is your ticket to managerial greatness. Manage both men and women, lead your club to unprecedented heights, and solidify your name as the next managerial legend.

[b]WE ARE FOOTBALL 2024[/b] isn't just a game, it's a celebration of football culture, strategy, and personalization. From creating your club's identity to influencing matches with tactical brilliance, every decision shapes your unique journey.

With a focus on realism, customization, and immersive gameplay, [b]WE ARE FOOTBALL 2024[/b] is set to elevate football management to new heights.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840987/1b77e97ed80b628624a219c7285b746e09cad879.jpg[/img]

Embark on your journey with a trio of thrilling game modes: Free club selection, club creation, and career mode. Develop your strategy and guide each player's development with individual skill trees. Dive deep into diverse manager functions, from finance and sponsors to HR and fan support, shaping every aspect of your club's destiny.

[b]WE ARE FOOTBALL 2024[/b] elevates your managerial prowess to the international stage. Take control in separate European Championship and World Championship modes for both men and women. Choose a national team to lead from the outset or field long-term takeover offers during gameplay, proving your mettle on a global scale.

Immerse yourself in the heart-pounding action with the enhanced 3D match displays featuring 9 cameras, slow-motion, replay, and dynamic live rating changes. Watch your tactical instructions come to life on the pitch, and seize the moment by intervening in decision-making situations. [b]WE ARE FOOTBALL 2024[/b] puts you in the gaffer's chair, where every decision shapes the course of the match.

Replicate reality or create your fantasy leagues with the expanded editor in [b]WE ARE FOOTBALL 2024[/b]. Customize any country with editable women's and men's leagues, allowing you to craft a football universe tailored to your vision: tweak league systems, logos, jerseys, and more with extensive editing options to suit YOUR needs.

[h2]Embark on YOUR Road to Glory![/h2]

Get ready to experience the excitement, challenges, and triumphs of football management. The Demo Version is now available, so dive in, craft your legacy, and let the roar of the crowd propel you to greatness!
